card_description: Bill Hamilton is a character in Philip K. Dick's *Eye in the Sky*. Jack Hamilton's companion through the subjective realities. Name note: Jack's wife (Marsha in some editions). The partner who shares the journey through other minds. First appears in *Eye in the Sky*.
